title: Wellingtons LA Shark Tank Story: What They Are and How to Order Them
summary: Wellingtons LA brought frozen Beef Wellingtons to Shark Tank Season 15. Here's what happened and how to order them on Goldbelly.

## They left Shark Tank without a deal, then they hit $3.7 million in sales anyway


Wellingtons LA makes gourmet, ready-to-bake frozen Beef Wellingtons. Filet mignon wrapped in puff pastry, shipped to your door and oven-ready in about an hour. Founded by Arya Alexander and Anastasia Geroulis, the Los Angeles brand went national after appearing on Shark Tank Season 15 and now ships nationwide on Goldbelly.


[Order the Wellingtons LA Shark Tank Sampler on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/wellingtons-la/holiday-beef-wellington-shark-tank-sampler)


## **The Shark Tank Story**


On a Wednesday in April 2020, Arya Alexander and Anastasia Geroulis were home in Los Angeles wondering what to make for dinner. They turned on the TV, saw Gordon Ramsay cooking Beef Wellington, and were inspired. They made one that night. It turned out so good that they started selling them to friends and family, and Wellingtons LA was born.


Three years later, they appeared on Shark Tank Season 15, Episode 3, which aired October 13, 2023, asking for $200,000 for 10% equity. The Sharks loved the product but passed on the deal. Kevin O’Leary was already selling a competing product, Mark Cuban found the sales model too complex, and the others followed. Arya and Anastasia left without a deal.


What happened next is the more interesting story.


## **Wellingtons LA After Shark Tank**


The episode drove a surge in traffic and sales. Wellingtons LA crossed $600,000 in annual revenue in 2023 and has since surpassed $3.7 million in total lifetime sales, all while remaining 100% founder-owned.


Taking Kevin O’Leary’s on-air advice to heart, the founders shifted focus toward direct-to-consumer sales and refined their cold-chain shipping process. They expanded into Costco, launched Welly Bites for entertaining, and added a[Shark Tank Sampler pack](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/wellingtons-la/holiday-beef-wellington-shark-tank-sampler) for fans who discovered them through the show.


Goldbelly became an early home for the brand, connecting Wellingtons LA with exactly the kind of food-curious customer who appreciates a premium, giftable product with a great story behind it.


## **What Is a Wellingtons LA Beef Wellington?**


Wellingtons LA takes the classic fine-dining dish and makes it doable at home. Each Wellington is beef tenderloin wrapped in mushroom duxelles (shallots, garlic, rosemary, thyme, and mushrooms) with Dijon mustard, brushed with egg wash and topped with sea salt. Each one ships fully prepped and frozen. Pop it in the oven from frozen for about an hour and serve.


Beyond the classic, the founders have Wellington-ified just about everything. Current flavors and formats available on[Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/wellingtons-la) include:


- **Wellington Best Sellers 4-Pack** — two Classic Wellingtons and two Cheeseburger Wellingtons
- **Classic Beef Wellington** — the original, with 12 oz filet mignon per serving
- **Family Size Beef Wellington** — 40 oz filet mignon, serves 4 to 6
- **Cheeseburger Wellington** — beef patties, American cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños in puff pastry with sesame seeds
- **Breakfast Wellington** — a morning twist on the classic
- **Nutellington** — Nutella in puff pastry, for those who want something sweet
- **Burger Wellington Bites** — 15-pack, snack-sized and great for parties


## **How to Order Wellingtons LA Nationwide**


Wellingtons LA ships nationwide on Goldbelly. Orders arrive frozen with dry ice. Bake straight from frozen and do not thaw the pastry first or it will lose its flaky texture. The Shark Tank Sampler is the best place to start if you want to try a few flavors at once.
